newsitem.title: DEMOCRATIC REPUBLIC OF CONGO: Another Mobutu ally arrested in new Congo.
newsitem.headline: Another Mobutu ally arrested in new Congo.

text.p: Laurent Kabila's government has arrested another staunch ally of ex-president Mobutu Sese Seko in a crackdown on dignitaries of the former Zaire.

Justice Minister Celestin Lwangy said on state television on Saturday that Bemba Saolona, an affluent businessman and former president of the national business association, had been arrested in connection with mismanagement of public money.
Since ousting Mobutu in a successful rebellion two months ago, the government of Kabila's Democratic Republic of the Congo has arrested more than 30 people associated with the former regime.
Lwangy said the arrests were not politically motivated.
"They are being investigated under common law...I cannot at this stage give any details of the investigations," he said.
